_comment: Synthetic multi-session ClinicalFact-shaped mentions for one patient (E3-S1 story). Do NOT vendor MedLoCoMo text here — every string below is invented for this fixture. session 2, colloquial description — documented, NOT bridged by this story's lexical-only blocking (see resolve.py module docstring); kept in the fixture on purpose so the honest gap is exercised by a test, not hidden
